scope: Official ECOR WGS input authentication only; no annotations, labels, model fitting or target scores
roster: All25 observed-panel hosts from the prior accession audit; no outcomes read. The two metadata-only hosts ECOR36/37 remain outside this prior panel roster.
pilot_disclosure: ECOR12 master, assembly XML and compressed WGS FASTA were inspected to establish the route before this bulk policy. Reuse the authenticated master/FASTA pilot bytes for ECOR12; fetch remaining24 under the same rule.
route_authority: ENA official browser/FTP documentation; ECOR12 assembly XML independently lists this FASTA URL
strain_rule: Exact MOD1-ECORn master strain for ECORn source mapping
identity_controls: Master prefix must equal frozen WGS accession prefix
Require WGS build/set declaration and complete inclusive contig range
Validate gzip CRC, exact expected contig set, unique versioned accessions, nonempty IUPAC DNA and per-contig strain declarations
Never concatenate, trim, fill or choose longest contigs
source_metric_rule: Compare master contig count to supplied Scaffolds as a descriptive source-metric check; preserve any discrepancy without silently substituting genomes
outputs: Raw master and compressed/expanded original FASTA retained; full per-contig IDs, lengths and sequence SHA256 in raw manifest; compact hash-bound public receipt
failure_rule: Retain failed/pending entries; do not create zero-length sequences or omit a host from the roster
limits: WGS builds and contig sequence versions are distinct. Accession identity does not establish experimental-stock equivalence or training admission. GCA mapping beyond the ECOR12 pilot is not inferred.
